chunks: Hadith 402 — The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله passed by a grave whose occupant was being punished. So he called for a palm branch, split it into two halves, and placed one at his head and the other at his feet.

And it has been narrated: the occupant of the grave was Qays ibn Fahd al-Ansari. And it has been narrated: Qays ibn Qumayr. And it was said to him, 'Why did you place them?' So he said, 'Indeed, the punishment is lightened for him so long as they remain green.'
ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله place fresh palm branches on a grave?
ai.summary: This report describes the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله taking an action at a grave whose occupant was under punishment, placing two fresh palm branches at the head and feet. The narration indicates that the punishment was lightened while the branches remained green, and it also preserves variant reports about the identity of the buried person.
